gui.the_long_travail.catalog.floral.spri: A Spring Corner with free flower slots can be crafted with additional flowers, holding one main flower and two supporting flowers of distinct types. Each flower grants a special effect.
Craft Spring Corner with a water bucket to remove all supporting flowers while retaining the main flower.
gui.the_long_travail.catalog.floral.affe: While holding Affection, right-click your companion to form a pact. Right-click that companion again to end the pact. Sneak-right-click air to clear an existing pact.
After forming a pact, only the owner can equip it.
The following effects require both wearer and companion to be alive, in the same dimension, and within %s blocks of each other.
When the wearer is below full health, the companion gains:
When the companion is below full health, the wearer gains:
- Movement speed bonus = companion missing-health fraction × %s%%.
gui.the_long_travail.catalog.floral.mist: Hold Mistletoe and right-click a non-player creature to apply Mistletoe for %s seconds.
Repeated use raises the effect by 1 level and extends its duration by %s seconds, up to level %s. At the maximum level, further uses still extend the duration.
For each level of Mistletoe on the target:
- Deal source-less magic damage equal to %s%% of the target’s maximum health per level;
- Make one Parasitic Separation roll, with a %s%% success chance per effect level.
Removing the effect early or the target dying before natural expiration prevents backlash damage and extra drops.
Each successful use consumes 1 Mistletoe. Nothing is consumed if the target cannot accept the effect.
gui.the_long_travail.catalog.floral.ever: While equipped, accelerate growth for most plants within %s blocks horizontally and %s blocks above and below the wearer. Overlapping areas do not stack growth speed.
Sneak-right-click while holding it to enable or disable growth acceleration.
While wearing The Long Travail with Flourishing Malice:
While wearing The Long Travail with Flourishing Witness:
- Dealing damage has a %s%% chance to grant Resistance %s for %s seconds;
- In Sunflower Plains, Flower Forests, Cherry Groves, or Meadows, movement speed increases by %s%% and damage taken decreases by %s%%.
- Dealing damage has a %s%% chance to trigger equal additional damage. Each successful repeat has the same chance to repeat again;
- In Sunflower Plains, Flower Forests, Cherry Groves, or Meadows, gain a %s%% damage bonus.
Shapelessly craft Immortal Bud with an eligible durable item to fully repair it and grant the Evergreen mark, preventing durability loss.
Each craft consumes 1 Immortal Bud. Already marked items cannot receive the mark again.
Apart from repairing durability and adding the mark, the item’s name, enchantments, and other data are preserved.
Immortal Bud itself resists fire, lava, and explosions as a dropped item and does not naturally despawn.
